---
title: "Schedule"
---

Eight weeks, **online**, one session every **Saturday from 19:30 to 22:30** (Vietnam time), from **31 October to 19 December 2026**: eight sessions of **3 hours** (with a 15-minute break), Session *n* in Week *n*. There are no groups: the whole class works through every exercise together, and each participant builds their own proposal and manuscript as homework. Weeks 1–4 build understanding and design skills; Weeks 5–8 read the results of the simulated **FLUID-ICU** dataset through live instructor demos, and each participant writes them up as a manuscript. The whole course is **Level 1** ([course levels](levels.qmd)).

| Week | Session | Day | Theme | You build (homework) |
|:---:|:--------|:--------|:----------|:------------------------------------|
| 1 | [Session 1](session1.qmd) | Saturday 31/10/2026 | **Ask** | Proposal: topic, PICO, question, aims |
| 2 | [Session 2](session2.qmd) | Saturday 07/11/2026 | **Find & read** | Proposal: search, 5 references, problem statement, title |
| 3 | [Session 3](session3.qmd) | Saturday 14/11/2026 | **Design** | Proposal: design, setting, population |
| 4 | [Session 4](session4.qmd) | Saturday 21/11/2026 | **Bias & effect** | Proposal: exposure, outcomes, bias plan |
| 5 | [Session 5](session5.qmd) | Saturday 28/11/2026 | **Data** | Proposal: variables, CRF, data plan · Manuscript: Table 1 understood |
| 6 | [Session 6](session6.qmd) | Saturday 05/12/2026 | **Analyse** | Proposal: sample size, analysis plan · Manuscript: results interpreted |
| 7 | [Session 7](session7.qmd) | Saturday 12/12/2026 | **Protect & write** | Proposal: ethics, feasibility, publication plan · Manuscript: Methods + Results |
| 8 | [Session 8](session8.qmd) | Saturday 19/12/2026 | **Publish** | Manuscript: complete draft · Proposal submitted (about 5 volunteers present) |

## Detailed timetables

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" appearance="simple"}
## Session 1 · Ask: from clinical problem to research question

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 20 | Welcome, course map, the two individual products, how each session runs, introductions in the chat, how we work online (chat, polls, raise hand), ground rules |
| 0:20 | 19:50 | 15 | Pre-course quiz (online form) |
| 0:35 | 20:05 | 35 | **1.1 Why research?** Anecdote vs evidence, why small numbers mislead, the two course papers (Paper 1 Boulet 2024, Paper 2 Hyun 2023), evidence pyramid, research cycle, types of research, the journey from idea to publication (research vs audit vs QI is in the extra slides) |
| 1:10 | 20:40 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 20:55 | 40 | **1.2 From problem to question:** where questions come from, PICO(T) with several worked examples, descriptive vs analytical questions, vague vs answerable, FINER, whole-class task: rescue the running example |
| 2:05 | 21:35 | 20 | **1.3 Aims, objectives, hypotheses** (null vs alternative) + quick individual exercise |
| 2:25 | 21:55 | 30 | **Proposal builder 1:** the instructor models Part 1 live on the running example (topic, PICO, research question, FINER check, aim and objectives); each participant drafts their own Part 1 (finished as homework); two volunteers share |
| 2:55 | 22:25 | 5 | Wrap-up, homework |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows Vietnam time for the online 19:30–22:30 session. All exercises are done by the whole class together (no groups). **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).

| 0:10 | 19:40 | 45 | **3.1 Study designs in pictures:** descriptive vs analytical, case report/series, cross-sectional, case-control, cohort, RCT, systematic review/meta-analysis, evidence pyramid, decision tree, strengths & weaknesses, what each design can claim |

| 1:55 | 21:25 | 15 | Whole-class exercise: choose the design for 5 questions (poll); each participant then names the design for their own question in the chat |
| 2:10 | 21:40 | 45 | **Proposal builder 3:** inclusion and exclusion criteria, then modelled live (design + justification, setting, population, inclusion/exclusion); each participant drafts their own (finished as homework); three volunteers share in the chat |
| 2:55 | 22:25 | 5 | Wrap-up |

## Session 4 · Bias & effect: can we trust it, how big is it?

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |

| 0:50 | 20:20 | 25 | **4.2 Measuring disease and association:** prevalence vs incidence, risk, 2×2, RR / OR / RD / NNT, OR vs RR; **live 2×2 calculator demo** |

| 1:45 | 21:15 | 30 | **4.3 Beyond single studies:** diagnostic accuracy (sens/spec, PPV & prevalence, ROC), systematic reviews & forest plots, heterogeneity, risk-of-bias tools, "are the conclusions supported?" (whole-class task) |
| 2:15 | 21:45 | 40 | **Proposal builder 4:** outcomes, then modelled live (exposure & comparator, outcomes, main biases & mitigation); each participant drafts their own (finished as homework); three volunteers share in the chat |
| 2:55 | 22:25 | 5 | Wrap-up |

## Session 6 · Analyse: from sample to answer

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 19:40 | 40 | **6.1 From sample to population:** CI, p-values & misinterpretations, one-sided vs two-sided tests, type I/II errors, power, sample size (**5-minute live demo**), choosing a test (decision table), paired vs unpaired, multiple comparisons |
| 0:50 | 20:20 | 20 | **6.2 [DS] Compare groups in the course dataset:** live demo (t-test / Mann-Whitney / chi-square); the class interprets the outputs together (Q1 in full, Q2 to Q5 briefly) |
| 1:10 | 20:40 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:25 | 20:55 | 35 | **6.3 Relationships and models:** correlation, linear and logistic regression, adjustment, reading a regression table, overfitting, censoring and Kaplan-Meier curves (prediction/ML and interaction in the extra slides) |
| 2:00 | 21:30 | 25 | **6.4 [DS] Model the course dataset:** the SAP that was written before the analysis, crude vs adjusted OR (confounding by indication made visible), Kaplan-Meier + Cox HR, complete-case vs multiple imputation |
| 2:25 | 21:55 | 30 | **Proposal builder 6:** modelled live (sample size, analysis plan, confounders, missing-data plan); each participant drafts their own sample-size inputs (finished as homework) |
| 2:55 | 22:25 | 5 | Wrap-up |
